environment.binary_values: Existing pool/ADD values reconstructed in memory only. No raw instruction immediate values from the arithmetic chain exported; instruction templates retain only opcode/register bits. No transformed ELF saved.

decision.bounded_improvement: One pinned arm/mode raw32 reconstruction may change ONLY its derived fourth dword, with the other seven dwords byte-identical. Literal pools are not modified. Existing three non-flag-setting ADD immediate fields are solved exactly modulo 2^32; unrepresentable deltas return zero matches. This is useful offline machinery and a restricted positive fixture, not a deployable key replacement.
decision.why_not_full_pool_mutation: Stripped ELF has only .dynsym, no complete ARM/Thumb/data mapping or computed-pointer ownership proof. Unique aligned A32 LDR references and lack of absolute pointer/relocation hits do not prove exclusive pool ownership. Leaving pools immutable avoids inventing that proof.

implemented_contract.target: RouterOS 7.24.4 arm/nova/bin/mode, ELF32 LE EM_ARM, ET_EXEC, flags 0x05000200
implemented_contract.only_mutable_bits: Bottom 12 immediate-encoding bits of each exact AL ADD r3,r3,imm instruction; opcode/register/condition/S bits preserved. No inserted instructions or size changes.
implemented_contract.register_lifetime: r3 stores the old third word, then three ADDs derive fourth word and STR stores it; next LDR overwrites r3 before subsequent words. Final LDM at 59812 is also checked and included in envelope. Setup lr=r4-880 and ip=r4 unchanged; LDM reads outside the key buffer r4-840..-809. No calls, branches or intermediate r3 observations inside exact arithmetic chain. S=0 preserves flags.
validation: Whole pristine bytes SHA-256; unknown/repatched input rejected.
Unique RX PT_LOAD ownership for executable sections, file/virtual section and segment aliases refused.
Capstone fixed-width complete A32 decoding plus exact raw instruction fields and output ADD roundtrip.
Seven unique aligned PC-relative literal references; overlapping unaligned loads and explicit absolute pool pointers refused even though pools remain immutable.
Aligned A32 B/BL/BLX direct entry scan, entry point/function-symbol interior checks and REL/RELA envelope/pool overlap rejection.
Reconstructed eight-word original equals caller old value; other seven new words must remain identical.
Exact modular three-immediate solver including carry/wrap, no key-derived caches or logs.

OfflineMatch represents one reconstruction/count=1, three write triples, full instruction envelope and all read-only pool dependencies. preflight checks every dependency range for other mapping overlap. No automatic production statistics or application API.
implemented_contract.control_flow_limit: Not a generic whole-program computed-pointer/Thumb CFG proof. Indirect instruction-entry assumptions remain restricted to the pristine whole-file pin, as in existing PPC matcher style; direct checks are defense in depth. Full arbitrary pool/key mutation intentionally remains unsupported. Review must evaluate this pinned local instruction-equivalence scope, not infer universal ARM support.
